title: Character coherence: one human cast, one theme, tied to the design style

Retheme or redraw the customers the theme changes; six human shopkeepers if approved; check the four start icons
The screen, the printed cards, the character pick and the gallery all draw the same portraits from the same data
Optional, owner decides: idle, happy and sad frames
exclusions: Changing any perk, order or rule
New customers beyond replacements the owner asks for
